_meta.purpose: Published-consensus clinical reference ranges used by tools/indicator_content_validity.py to compare against HealthLens's data/indicator_dictionary.yaml. Complements L-CVI (axis-level construct triangulation); together they form a two-source AI-only substitute for expert Delphi CVI.
_meta.not_a_substitute_for: Expert mini-Delphi (5-8 TCM/clinical experts, 2 rounds, S-CVI/Ave >= 0.78)
_meta.tolerance: ±10% relative tolerance for numeric ref_range and unit_alt factors (to allow for inter-lab and inter-method variability); exact string match for unit_si
_meta.definition_of_ref_range: Clinical reference interval (the laboratory-normal range for in_range assessment), NOT disease-risk threshold. LDL 'no lower bound' is used here because LDL below 2.6 mmol/L is generally considered normal in adults (below 2.6 may be associated with increased all-cause mortality in observational data — de Lange 2007 J Epidemiol Community Health); disease-specific LDL targets (e.g. ESC/EAS 1.8 or 1.4 mmol/L for very-high-risk) are treatment targets, not reference intervals. Similarly, BP thresholds (e.g. ESH 2023 defines ≥130 systolic as hypertension) are risk thresholds; the CLSI reference range 90-120 is the lab-normal.

sources.glucose_hba1c: ADA Standards of Care 2024; IDF 2021; IFCC 2017 HbA1c reference interval; Chinese Type 2 Diabetes Guideline 2020
sources.hs_crp: Ridker 2001 Circulation (lab-normal for hs-CRP < 1.0 mg/L in men, < 1.0 mg/L in non-smoking women; stricter 0.5 mg/L subgroups for female cardiovascular-risk stratification per Ridker 2003 Lancet)
sources.cholesterol_lipids: CLSI 2010 lipid panel reference intervals; WHO 2019; Chinese Lipid Management Guideline 2023; NCEP ATP III reference intervals
sources.kidney_function: CLSI 2013 creatinine reference intervals; KDIGO 2024 CKD-EPI 2021 reference intervals
sources.thyroid: ATA 2017 thyroid disease guideline (TSH 0.4-4.0 mIU/L adult reference)
sources.bmi_bp: WHO Adult Obesity Classifications 2000; Chinese Adult Weight Management Guideline 2023; CLSI 2010 BP reference intervals; ESH 2023 (adult lab-normal BP 90-139 / 60-89)
sources.uric_acid: CLSI 2008 uric acid reference intervals; EULAR 2016 gout guideline

glucose.source: ADA 2024 (fasting glucose 3.9-6.1 mmol/L adult); IDF 2021; Chinese Type 2 Diabetes Guideline 2020

hba1c.source: ADA 2024 (normal <5.7% = <42 mmol/mol); IFCC 2017 consensus reference interval; IDF 2021

hs_crp.source: Ridker 2001 Circulation (hs-CRP < 1.0 mg/L lab-normal); Ridker 2003 Lancet (women < 0.5 mg/L subgroup)

total_cholesterol.source: CLSI 2010 lipid reference intervals (adult lab-normal TC < 5.2 mmol/L); WHO 2019; Chinese Lipid Guideline 2023

hdl.source: NCEP ATP III (HDL-C male ≥ 1.0 mmol/L, female ≥ 1.2 mmol/L as low-HDL threshold); CLSI 2010 HDL reference intervals (upper bound ~2.1-2.6 mmol/L adult lab-normal)

ldl.source: CLSI 2010 LDL reference intervals (adult lab-normal LDL < 3.4 mmol/L, no lower bound per de Lange 2007 J Epidemiol Community Health on LDL mortality paradox)

vldl.source: Friedewald equation: VLDL-C (mmol/L) = TG / 2.2; lower bound 0.18 mmol/L corresponds to TG floor of 0.4 mmol/L (CLSI TG lab-normal lower bound); upper bound VLDL-C < 1.0 mmol/L per WHO 2019. VLDL-C is a lipoprotein-cholesterol measurement so the mg/dL→mmol/L factor is 0.0259 (cholesterol molecular weight 386), not 0.0113 (that's TG).

triglycerides.source: CLSI 2010 triglyceride reference intervals (lab-normal adult TG 0.56-1.7 mmol/L = 50-150 mg/dL); NCEP ATP III borderline-high threshold at 1.7 mmol/L (150 mg/dL)

egfr.source: KDIGO 2024 CKD-EPI 2021 (eGFR 90-120 mL/min/1.73m2 typical adult reference); CKD-EPI Chinese cohort calibration 2021

creatinine.source: CLSI EP28-A2 2013 creatinine reference intervals; IFCC 2017 consensus reference interval

bun.source: Rosenbaum & Post 1969 pediatric reference; CLSI BUN method-specific reference intervals

uric_acid.source: CLSI 2008 uric acid reference intervals; EULAR 2016 gout guideline; ACR 2020

tsh.source: ATA 2017 thyroid guideline (adult TSH 0.27-4.2 mIU/L assay-dependent); Endocrine Society 2012

bmi.source: WHO Adult Obesity Classifications 2000 (BMI 18.5-24.0 adult normal); Chinese Adult Weight Management Guideline 2023 (senior BMI 22-26 associated with lowest mortality)

bp_sys.source: CLSI 2010 BP reference interval (lab-normal adult systolic 90-120 mmHg); ESH 2023 (threshold-based, not used as reference here)

bp_dia.source: CLSI 2010 BP reference interval (lab-normal adult diastolic 60-80 mmHg); ESH 2023
